claims: The Artemis II launch is scheduled for Wednesday, April 1, 2026.
The Artemis II launch has a two-hour window opening at 6:24 p.m. EDT.
Live coverage of the Artemis II launch is available online via NASA+, the NASA YouTube channel, FOX Weather, NBC News NOW, and Space.com.
Official coverage on NASA+ and YouTube includes full ascent and on-board views.
The Artemis II launch will be visible to the naked eye across most of Florida and parts of Georgia within 60–70 seconds of liftoff, according to the NASA visibility map.
